title: 程序员 Vibe Coding 第四批五张
startedAtNote: 本轮首个记录时钟时间，更早工具起点未记录，不补造。

cards.title: 上下文太多，也会迷路
cards.description_en: A programmer asks an AI assistant to keep only the context relevant to the current task.
cards.description_zh: 程序员让 AI 只保留与当前任务相关的上下文。
cards.communication_goal: 筛选必要上下文，避免无关信息干扰当前任务。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: There is too much context. Which files are relevant to this bug?
dialogue.zh: 上下文太多了，哪些文件与这个缺陷有关？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: The error log and the request handler are useful. The old design notes are not needed.
dialogue.zh: 错误日志和请求处理代码有用，旧的设计笔记不需要。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Filter out the unrelated files. I'll keep the error log on this screen.
dialogue.zh: 筛掉无关文件。我会在这个屏幕上保留错误日志。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll focus on those two sources and ask if I need more information.
dialogue.zh: 我会专注于这两份资料，需要更多信息时再问。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.scene_prompt: The adult stick-figure programmer sits at the left of a small desk and points toward a large desktop monitor at center. The monitor has a clear rectangular bezel and a fully blank black inner screen, outlined in white. Show the whole inner screen unobstructed; keep the pointing hand outside the bezel. The floating white OpenAI knot is at the right. A small pile of blank papers rests aside at the far left of the desk, representing unnecessary context, away from the monitor. No writing, symbols or UI text.
cards.image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The adult stick-figure programmer sits at the left of a small desk and points toward a large desktop monitor at center. The monitor has a clear rectangular bezel and a fully blank black inner screen, outlined in white. Show the whole inner screen unobstructed; keep the pointing hand outside the bezel. The floating white OpenAI knot is at the right. A small pile of blank papers rests aside at the far left of the desk, representing unnecessary context, away from the monitor. No writing, symbols or UI text.

words.example: There is too much context. Which files are relevant to this bug?
words.translation: 上下文太多了，哪些文件与这个缺陷有关？
words.evidence: 相关性由对白与任务决定，纸张或屏幕外观不能证明关联。

words.example: There is too much context. Which files are relevant to this bug?
words.translation: 上下文太多了，哪些文件与这个缺陷有关？
words.evidence: 这里是任务背景信息，不把整张图或纸堆当成其局部指代。

words.evidence: 这里指筛掉无关资料，静态画面不能证明确实完成筛选。

words.example: Filter out the unrelated files. I'll keep the error log on this screen.

words.evidence: 显示器内屏是实际可见指代；不声称能读取空白内屏中的日志。

cards.title: 交接前留下能恢复的记录
cards.description_en: A programmer asks an AI assistant to leave a handoff record so work can resume later.
cards.description_zh: 程序员让 AI 留下交接记录，以便稍后恢复工作。
cards.communication_goal: 记录已完成事项、待办与恢复入口。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Before we stop, record our progress so I can resume tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 结束前，记录我们的进度，方便我明天继续。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll note what changed, what passed, and what is still pending.
dialogue.zh: 我会记下改了什么、哪些检查通过了，以及哪些事项还待处理。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Add the next step and the file paths. I'll put a short summary in this notebook.
dialogue.zh: 加上下一步和文件路径。我会在这个笔记本里记一份简短摘要。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll leave a handoff note in the project and include the commands needed to continue.
dialogue.zh: 我会在项目里留下交接记录，并附上继续工作所需的命令。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

words.example: Before we stop, record our progress so I can resume tomorrow.

words.example: I'll note what changed, what passed, and what is still pending.
words.translation: 我会记下改了什么、哪些检查通过了，以及哪些事项还待处理。
words.evidence: 任务状态来自交接对白，不能从静态笔记本判断。

words.example: Add the next step and the file paths. I'll put a short summary in this notebook.
words.translation: 加上下一步和文件路径。我会在这个笔记本里记一份简短摘要。
words.evidence: 可见的纸质螺旋笔记本是直接指代，框完整封面与装订。

cards.title: 先做一条能走通的主流程
cards.description_en: A programmer and an AI assistant build a minimal flow before adding extra features.
cards.description_zh: 程序员与 AI 先打通最小主流程，再添加额外功能。
cards.communication_goal: 先完成可运行的主流程，用实际操作验证。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Start with a minimal flow: click this button and save one item.
dialogue.zh: 先做最小流程：点击这个按钮，保存一条记录。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Should I add filters and bulk editing now?
dialogue.zh: 现在要加筛选和批量编辑吗？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Not yet. Complete the basic flow first, then let me try it.
dialogue.zh: 先不用。先完成基本流程，再让我试一下。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll build that path and check that the saved item appears in the list.
dialogue.zh: 我会先实现这条路径，并检查保存的记录是否出现在列表里。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.title: 一次改一个可验证的功能
cards.description_en: A programmer asks an AI assistant to make one isolated change and verify its behavior.
cards.description_zh: 程序员让 AI 做一处独立改动，并验证其行为。
cards.communication_goal: 控制单次改动大小，先验证，再继续。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Add one switch for dark mode. Keep this change isolated.
dialogue.zh: 加一个深色模式开关，让这次改动保持独立。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll update only the setting and its behavior.
dialogue.zh: 我只会更新这个设置及其行为。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Verify it before starting the next incremental change.
dialogue.zh: 开始下一次渐进改动前，先验证它。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll check both positions of the switch and report the result.
dialogue.zh: 我会检查开关的两种状态，并报告结果。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

cards.title: 别让小需求变成全项目重写
cards.description_en: A programmer keeps a small request from turning into an unrelated refactor.
cards.description_zh: 程序员控制小需求的范围，避免扩展成无关重构。
cards.communication_goal: 明确允许修改的范围，审查差异后再批准。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: The request is to rename a button. Keep the scope small.
dialogue.zh: 需求是改一个按钮的名称，保持范围小。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Should I refactor the whole component while I'm here?
dialogue.zh: 要不要顺便重构整个组件？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: No. Leave unrelated code alone. I'll review the diff on this laptop.
dialogue.zh: 不要。别动无关代码，我会在这台笔记本电脑上审查差异。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll change only the label and show you the diff.
dialogue.zh: 我只会修改按钮文字，再把差异给你看。

roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）
